master_objective: Build a governed, portable agent-development ecosystem where Custom GPT/system prompts can be created, enhanced, epistemically audited, deployed, observed, performance-audited and improved without losing human/main-host authority.
direction_notes: Prompt Creator and Prompt Enhancer should share one specification-engineering core where behavior overlaps, with distinct create/enhance modes rather than duplicated logic.
Reasoning Auditor validates visible rationale/evidence and recursive iteration quality; it is advisory and must not request or store private chain-of-thought.
Future system reasoning records should be concise auditable decision records (claims/evidence/assumptions/alternatives/decisions/unknowns/verification), not hidden reasoning transcripts.
Eventually add a specialized Deep Research / agent-prompt architect layer for producing research prompts that generate new Custom GPT prompts.
Use real session evidence and Profile Performance Auditor before permanently promoting speculative governance machinery.
constraints: Current explicit user instruction always outranks the saved plan.
Do not duplicate semantically overlapping agent logic merely because separate Custom GPT labels exist.
No hidden chain-of-thought capture or requirement.
Reasoning-audit recommendations remain PENDING_MAIN_HOST until normal governance accepts them.
Preserve v0.18 latency routing and persistent-workspace delivery; no routine ZIP export.

parts.title: Integrate Prompt-Agent Foundation
parts.raw_user_intent: Here are the prompts; incorporate it optimally, as well as the plan.
parts.objective: Integrate Prompt Creator/Enhancer behavior without duplication, add Reasoning Auditor as a separate advisory profile, preserve full source prompts as references, and encode the development pipeline.
parts.rationale: Governance and shared agent contracts must exist before later recursive/self-audit workflows are promoted.
acceptance_criteria: Creator and Enhancer share one core module with distinct modes.
Reasoning Auditor is advisory-only and excludes private chain-of-thought.
Standalone prompt references are preserved outside core runtime bloat.
Full regression, convergence and PDF verification pass.
completion_evidence: Semantic convergence reached a stable fixed point in 2 passes.
Formats.pdf rule 1.1k.xi visually verified on page 14.
PDF_Workflow.pdf stage 2.7.12 visually verified on page 11.
Prompt source references preserved in Google Drive Agent Prompts folder.
next_actions: Validate Reasoning Auditor on a real Prompt Enhancer iteration trace after release closure.
parts.source_reference: Current Design project turn plus supplied Prompt Creator variants and Reasoning Auditor PDF.

parts.title: Validate Reasoning Auditor on Real Recursive Prompt Work
parts.raw_user_intent: Run the prompt enhancer on the newly generated reasoning auditor, get the reasoning behind enhancements, then embody reasoning auditor to check whether the reasoning is valid before confirming edits.
parts.objective: Use actual Prompt Enhancer iteration rationale and prompt deltas to test Reasoning Auditor usefulness, false-positive discipline, metric-drift detection and recursive-degradation detection before deeper runtime promotion.
acceptance_criteria: Audit receives visible rationale/deltas, not hidden reasoning.
Auditor separates supported flaws from unverifiable claims.
Main host, not auditor, decides whether edits are accepted.
next_actions: Run Reasoning Auditor against the completed three-iteration Prompt Enhancer trace and resulting prompt.
parts.source_reference: Qwen planning conversation supplied by user.

parts.title: Add Auditable Decision-Rationale Records
parts.raw_user_intent: Create a new entry in the system BIOS that makes agents record their reasoning into individual reasoning files so I can occasionally run a system reasoning check.
parts.objective: If Part 2 demonstrates value, add per-profile persistent decision records containing claims, evidence, assumptions, alternatives, decisions, unknowns and verification so Reasoning Auditor can inspect system reasoning without capturing private chain-of-thought.
acceptance_criteria: Privacy boundary explicitly forbids hidden chain-of-thought capture.
Records are concise, auditable and linked to outputs/code where applicable.
Periodic reasoning audits can identify rationale/output inconsistencies and route fixes through main governance.
next_actions: Design the record schema only after Part 2 evidence confirms the audit workflow is useful.
parts.source_reference: User roadmap in supplied Qwen conversation.

parts.title: Build Deep Research / Agent Prompt Architect
parts.raw_user_intent: The next step may as well be creating a custom agent for creating prompts for deep research to create custom prompts.
parts.objective: Create a specialized layer that turns an agent goal into a high-quality Deep Research brief for researching and producing a new Custom GPT/system prompt, then routes the result through Prompt Enhancer and Reasoning Auditor.
acceptance_criteria: Research prompt separates research questions from desired final agent behavior.
Generated agent prompts flow through enhancement and epistemic audit before deployment.
next_actions: Design after Reasoning Auditor validation establishes the governance gate.
parts.source_reference: User roadmap in supplied Qwen conversation.

parts.title: Operationalize Periodic Agent Quality Audits
parts.raw_user_intent: Occasionally run a system reasoning check to see errors in reasoning and the code generated as a result and to fix it.
parts.objective: Combine reasoning audits, artifact/code consistency checks and profile performance audits into periodic evidence-based reviews that propose bounded improvements without automatic self-authorization.
acceptance_criteria: Reasoning, output correctness and profile performance remain distinct audit dimensions.
Findings are evidence-linked and main-host governed.
No audit recursively mutates itself without normal lifecycle review.
next_actions: Define cadence and sampling only after decision-record evidence exists.
parts.source_reference: User roadmap in supplied Qwen conversation.
